description: This file defines columns for a model hub table component in a React frontend. It specifies how to render columns displaying model data, including provider info, capabilities, costs, and actions, with some UI logic and formatting functions.

methods.name: formatCapabilityName
methods.description: Formats the capability key by removing the 'supports_' prefix and converting underscores to spaces with proper capitalization.

methods.name: getModelCapabilities
methods.description: Extracts capabilities from the model object where support is true, returning the list of capability keys.

methods.name: formatCost
methods.description: Formats a numeric cost value into a dollar string with two decimal places, scaled to represent per million tokens.

methods.name: formatTokens
methods.description: Converts token counts into a human-readable string (e.g., 1.2M, 500K).
